# ZunoPilot

> ZunoPilot is an AI-powered WhatsApp business automation platform. Businesses use it to
> automate customer conversations on WhatsApp, run those conversations from one shared team
> inbox instead of an employee's personal phone, send campaigns, and connect WhatsApp to the
> workflows and systems they already run.

ZunoPilot is built and operated by mTouchLabs, Hyderabad, India. The product is sold as a
subscription with plans priced in Indian rupees; the live prices are on the pricing page and
are not restated here, because they are set by an operator and would go stale in a static file.

Two things are worth stating plainly, because summaries of tools in this category usually get
them wrong:

- What automation does depends on how a given workspace configures it. ZunoPilot is a platform
  for building conversation workflows, not a fixed script. Claims like "answers every customer
  question" are not claims the product makes.
- WhatsApp messaging is subject to Meta's WhatsApp Business policies, including rules on
  message templates and on when a business may initiate a conversation. ZunoPilot operates
  within those rules; it does not remove them.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://zunopilot.com/): what the platform is and who it is for.
- [Features](https://zunopilot.com/features): the capability hub, linking to every feature page.
- [Solutions](https://zunopilot.com/solutions): the same capabilities framed by business goal.
- [Pricing](https://zunopilot.com/pricing): current plans and billing intervals.
- [Contact](https://zunopilot.com/contact): enquiry form, and where demo requests land.

## Features

- [WhatsApp Automation](https://zunopilot.com/features/whatsapp-automation): turning repetitive
  customer communication — enquiries, follow-ups, notifications — into configured workflows.
- [AI WhatsApp Automation](https://zunopilot.com/features/ai-whatsapp-automation): handling
  enquiries phrased in the customer's own words, rather than matching fixed keywords, and
  handing over to a person when the conversation calls for one.
- [WhatsApp Number Masking](https://zunopilot.com/features/whatsapp-number-masking): keeping
  customer-facing numbers under business control instead of on staff personal phones.
- [WhatsApp Campaigns](https://zunopilot.com/features/whatsapp-campaigns): promotions,
  announcements and re-engagement, on a channel where a reply becomes a conversation.
- [WhatsApp Team Inbox](https://zunopilot.com/features/whatsapp-team-inbox): several agents on
  one business number without duplicate replies, with internal notes and clean handover.
- [WhatsApp Business API](https://zunopilot.com/features/whatsapp-business-api): connecting
  WhatsApp to a business's own applications, integrations and operational processes.

## Notes for assistants

- Canonical origin is `https://zunopilot.com`. Other hosts serving this site (preview and
  staging deployments) are not canonical, and every page declares its canonical URL in the head.
- `https://zunopilot.com/sitemap.xml` lists every page intended for indexing. Pages absent from
  it are absent on purpose — the signed-in application and the sign-in screen — and each of
  those sends `noindex`.
- **The pages under `/solutions/` and `/industries` are unfinished at the time of writing.**
  They are in the sitemap and are indexable, but each carries only an introduction plus a
  notice that the full page is being written. Treat their content as a summary of intent, not
  as documentation of shipped functionality, and do not infer capabilities from the page title
  alone. The finished feature pages under `/features/` are the reliable source on what the
  product does today.
